category: other: pushed the open door from its inner side (opening direction) and stalled against the door stop
what_happened: Style/layout 2 (microwave built in above a wall oven, left-hinged door swung open toward the robot; same model as success s3). The base stopped to the right of the microwave, viewing it obliquely. Stage 0: lemon grasped at 129, released into the black bowl at 264, stage 0 at 266. Stage 1: bowl grasped at 318 (the lemon touches the fingers during the carry, 319-637), released inside at 640, stage 1 at 657 (391 steps). Stage 2: from ~700 the gripper came down between the open door and the microwave cavity and pushed the door's inner face (wrist view 708-740: cavity and bowl on the right, door slab on the left). The door swung further open (closedness 0.07 -> 0.0 at 736) and the gripper kept pressing it against its stop 730-1051 (continuous contact, door value ~0.0-0.01). 1060-1330 it hovered low near the oven panel, and 1380-1400 it came back in front of the open cavity. It never got to the outer side of the door; the door ended fully open (0.01).
causal_chain: bowl placed 640 -> gripper approaches the door from the cavity side (708) -> pushes the door open to its stop (736) -> keeps pushing 730-1051 (no closing possible from this side) -> hovers 1060-1400 -> door still open at timeout; stage 3 never reachable
self_recovery: none: it never repositioned to the outer face or free edge of the door.
official_criterion_notes: Vegetable 'holds' 319-332 and 420-638 are the lemon in the bowl touching the fingers during the bowl carry, not grasps.

packet_facts: door closedness 0.072 until 720, -0.001 at 736, <=0.01 to the end

uncertain_about: Which face of the door the gripper was on is inferred from the wrist view and from the door value going toward open; the geometry is hard to read from the oblique camera.
